## GitHub Platform Questions

Questions about **GitHub itself** (Insights, Actions, settings, etc.) are outside the scope of this issue tracker. Please use the resources below instead:

| Topic | Resource |
|---|---|
| **Repository Insights** (traffic, contributors, commits) | [GitHub Docs – Repository Insights](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/viewing-activity-and-data-for-your-repository/using-pulse-to-view-a-summary-of-repository-activity) |
| **Traffic data** (views, clones, referrers) | [GitHub Docs – Repository Traffic](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/viewing-activity-and-data-for-your-repository/viewing-traffic-to-a-repository) |
| **GitHub Actions** questions | [GitHub Docs – Actions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions) |
| **General GitHub help** | [GitHub Support](https://support.github.com) |

### How to view Insights for your repository

1. Navigate to your repository on GitHub.
2. Click the **Insights** tab in the top navigation bar.
3. From the left sidebar, choose the view you want:
   - **Pulse** – recent activity summary
   - **Contributors** – commit history by author
   - **Traffic** – views, unique visitors, clones, and referring sites
   - **Commits** – commit frequency over time
   - **Code frequency** – additions and deletions over time
   - **Dependency graph** – upstream/downstream dependency links

> **Note:** Traffic data (views, clones) is only visible to repository owners and collaborators with push access. It is retained for 14 days.

## Filing a Thorne UI Issue

Please use one of the provided issue templates:

- 🐛 **Bug Report** – something in the UI is broken or behaves incorrectly
- ✨ **Feature Request** – a new window, element, or option variant
- 🧪 **UI Testing Finding** – a defect discovered during a testing session

If none of the templates fit, check the [Development Roadmap](../.docs/ROADMAP-v0.8.0.md) and [Standards](../.docs/STANDARDS.md) first—your question may already be answered there.
